description: This source file defines CLI commands for database management in the Mattermost project, including initialization, reset, migration, downgrade, and version retrieval.

methods.name: initDbCmdF
methods.description: Initializes the database connection and loads configuration, used as the run function for 'db init' command.

methods.name: resetCmdF
methods.description: Resets the database by dropping all tables after user confirmation.

methods.name: migrateCmdF
methods.description: Generates and optionally saves a migration plan, then applies migrations to the database.

methods.name: downgradeCmdF
methods.description: Downgrades the database either by specified version numbers or by applying a migration plan read from a file.

methods.name: dbVersionCmdF
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the current database schema version or all applied migrations if specified.

methods.name: ConfigToFileBackendSettings
methods.description: Converts file settings configuration into a filestore backend settings object, considering compliance and verification options.
